newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt air travel up 3.9pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt air travel up 3.9pct in May.

text.p: Air travel at Frankfurt airport grew 3.9 percent in May as consumers took advantage of four public holidays to take more foreign holidays than usual, airport authority figures showed.
But business travel within Germany declined 1.9 percent due to the unusually high number of public holidays, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) traffic report said.
The convenient holidays generated a clear pick-up in demand for leisure travel. Tourist destinations in Spain, Turkey, Egypt and the Far East were especially popular," the report noted.
The overall seat load factor of aircraft using the airport rose to 67.5 percent last month from 65.1 percent 12 months previously.
